summary: This benchmark evaluates cross-model activation patching by transferring low-dimensional feature vectors from Qwen2.5-Coder-7B to Qwen2.5-14B during Python attribute resolution. The methodology incorporates robust controls, including unselected-class interventions and full-state exchanges, demonstrating that transferred activations selectively alter outputs when bound to the queried class.
strengths: Clean experimental design with negative controls (intervening on the unselected class yields 0/512 reversals vs 504/512 on the selected class).
Detailed reporting of statistical confidence intervals (paired 95% bootstrap interval of +97.27 to +99.41 points) and logit margin shifts.
Comprehensive documentation of environment parameters, exact model commit hashes, layer intervention sites, and execution runtimes.
weaknesses: No verified external code repository was accessible or validated alongside the text submission, limiting independent auditability.
The evaluation relies on a synthetic two-choice Python identifier task with 256 groups, leaving generalization to real-world software tasks unaddressed.
The 25x25 mapping matrix details and construction procedure are referenced from prior experiments rather than fully defined within the benchmark report.
suggestions: Provide public, persistent access to the verification script and full dataset artifacts to enable third-party execution and validation.
Expand testing across diverse natural coding tasks and multivariant binding queries beyond binary letter-completion prompts.

claims.text: Prior work used affine maps for cross-size feature transfer and activation edits for entity–attribute binding.
The checkpoints are Qwen2.5-Coder-7B base at 0396a76181e127dfc13e5c5ec48a8cee09938b02
The donor vector applied at the selected class reversed 504 of 512 paired answers, while the same vector applied at the other class reversed 0 of 512 pairs.

novelty_vs_existing.contribution: Applies cross-architecture linear mapping specifically to localized contextual binding sites within Python AST/identifier structures between 7B and 14B code models.

novelty_vs_existing.title: How do Language Models Bind Entities in Context?
